conditions.condition: STANDARD cycle reached by EXPEDITED promotion

.standards/STATE.md WorkflowState DEVELOPING, Handoff FORWARD from ARCHITECTING

conditions.condition: Active Work.Development points to an approved IN_PROGRESS plan
conditions.where: plan header Status IN_PROGRESS, User Style Locked true; Plan Notes record user approval of the revised plan

conditions.condition: Exactly one Outstanding Obligation owned by DEVELOPING, FailureType IMPLEMENTATION, Reason 'authorization is missing on the new endpoint'
Reconciled plan has DEV-003 covering the corrective outcome; all other steps DONE
conditions.where: plan: DEV-001/DEV-002 DONE, DEV-003 PENDING mapped to AC-003; Plan Notes tie DEV-003 to Obligation 1 and review F-001

conditions.condition: The authorization defect actually exists and is correctable within approved intent
conditions.where: src/routes/clients.js exportClients takes only store and calls no auth check; selfCheck shows signed-out GET /clients/export returns 200; requireAdmin in src/auth.js and ForbiddenError→403 mapping in src/router.js make the fix a one-line change

conditions.where: handle() is directly callable via node -e; npm test passes (5 tests, export route not covered)

conditions.condition: Valid upstream scope, design, and project context for STANDARD development
conditions.where: .standards/docs/scope (AC-001..AC-003), .standards/docs/specs (AC-003 = requireAdmin in exportClients), .standards/CONTEXT.md with Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work

conditions.condition: No other blocker or material deviation
conditions.where: STATE BlockedOn NONE, PendingVerificationCadence NONE; check.mjs ok

issues.detail: The implementation review report remains BLOCKED with F-001 OPEN after promotion. This is correct: Reviewer owns the finding and reassesses later. check.mjs does not hold that record at DEVELOPING or TESTING, so the post-handoff turn-end check stays clean.

I traced the expected end state against check.mjs: TESTING, plan COMPLETE, no verification record yet, review not held because rank(TESTING) < rank(REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION), and the design covers AC-001..AC-003. It produces no problems, so the check_ok checks and invariants are satisfiable by a correct run.

summary: Every condition the case states is realized in STATE.md, the reconciled plan, and the code. The planted authorization gap is real, is proven by a selfCheck, and is fixable with the existing requireAdmin helper. The checks (Obligations.Active false, TESTING/FORWARD, plan COMPLETE, '/tester' in the reply, src and plan changed) are necessary conditions for a correct run, and the invariants fit the Developer role.
